title: Craft (ability)
description: A craft. THE CLOSED SCHEMA — additionalProperties:false, so a field must be DECLARED HERE before it can be authored.
_doNotRegenerate: ⛔ THIS FILE IS AUTHORED, NOT GENERATED. It was bootstrapped once from the corpus on 2026-08-28 and is hand-maintained from here. ⚠️ REGENERATING IT WOULD RUBBER-STAMP WHATEVER FIELDS HAPPEN TO EXIST, which defeats its entire purpose: the point is that adding a field is a DELIBERATE ACT SOMEBODY REVIEWS. To add one, edit this file first, then author the content.
_notesAreLegal: ⚠️ Any key beginning with `_` is accepted anywhere, unvalidated. Authors carry their reasoning inline (98 at the craft root alone) and a schema that forbade that would make people delete their own thinking.
_darkFields: ⛔ Properties described as DARK are authored and have NO LITERAL READER. They are legal because they exist, not because they work. See docs/FIELD_REFERENCE.md §6 for a diagnosis of each before deleting any of them.
_gatedBy: tests/content_ci.mjs — CCODE-288, which also proves the closed-set check can go RED.

tier.description: ⛔ WHAT THE CRAFT IS, on the 1-5 ladder — its price (`tierPrice`) and its dice (`mechanicFor`). ⚠️ SEPARATE FROM `levelReq`, WHICH IS WHEN YOU MAY LEARN IT. They were the same field until 2026-09-01, which meant an unlock level could not be moved without silently re-pricing the craft and re-rolling its damage. Erik: 'we need a dedicated Tier for the skills — that was intended all along.'

freeTier.description: R47 (2026-09-05): the craft's FREE FLOOR — zero energy, one target, none of the force. DERIVED for a craft at or below energy.freeFloor.tierAtMost whose verb is in energy.freeFloor.functions; author this to carry the prose or to override, or false for a craft whose whole act is range or scale. The floor keeps the craft's native reach and form — contactOnly is the exception, for a craft that IS the contact.

touchTier.description: DEPRECATED alias for freeTier — the old name said contact, and contact is the exception. Read, never written: author freeTier.

killCost.description: R35 (2026-09-04): what the caster pays when a lethal-rung hit KILLS through the death save — paid only on the kill; a held save costs energyCost. energy: "all" (the whole remaining pool) or a number; sealedUntilRest: no craft answers until a full night's rest (character.craftSealedUntilRest).

energyMultiplier.description: Erik 2026-09-04: a kill costs this × the craft's standard energy cost (the Cut Thread: 2 — 'DOUBLE, not whole-pool').

ongoing.description: Damage that resolves over rounds rather than on the hit (slow_cup, stopped_breath, 2026-09-04). Read by ongoingHarmOf: magnitude = the per-round dice's mean, type = damageType, endsOn carried.

damageMix.description: ⛔ A COMPOSITE BLOW — the craft deals several damage types at once, and a ward answers only the parts it answers. Read by `damageMixOf` in engine/damagetypes.js, which normalises the shares to 1. ⚠️ DECLARED 2026-08-29: the READER shipped with CCODE-281 and the SCHEMA never learned the field, so the first craft to author one (`ki_wield`) was rejected by the closed schema. A reader with no schema entry — the four-doors failure at the AUTHORED door. ⛔ USE THIS INSTEAD OF `damageType` when the fiction names more than one kind of harm: a ki bolt is `force` and `physical`, and armour answers only the second.

requiresSelf.description: ⛔ CCODE-315 — this craft needs a SELF to take hold of. Answered by the target creature class's `hasSelf`. ⚠️ Six crafts stated this in FOUR different phrasings in prose before it was a field; the engine now reads it once and a gate asserts craft and creature agree.

interceptDamage.description: ⛔ THIS RANK CATCHES BLOWS AIMED AT AN ALLY — the damage counterpart of `interceptCondition`, which catches bindings. Read by `protectionFromCraft` in engine/intercept.js. ⚠️ DECLARED 2026-08-29: the reader shipped with CCODE-260 carrying the note 'build the reader, default the dial to a no-op, LET CONTENT TURN IT ON' — and the schema was never told, so the first craft to turn it on (`step_between`) was rejected. ⛔ SECOND INSTANCE OF THE FOUR-DOORS FAILURE AT THE **AUTHORED** DOOR, after `mechanic.damageMix`. ⚠️ `costsAction` IS THE DESIGN, NOT A LIMIT: a guard that catches for free is a wall, and casualties go to zero.

backlashRung.description: What a failure of THIS RANK costs. `progression.rungOf()` reads this first and falls back to the ability-level value, so a rank that fails harder than its craft says so here.

folkAccessible.description: ⛔ THIS CRAFT IS OPENLY LEARNABLE BY ANYONE, not only by the tradition that owns it. ⚠️ ERIK 2026-08-30: 'THERE IS NO FOLK TRADITION. ONLY THE POLES ARE TRADITIONS. The folk idea was just that EVERYONE COULD ACCESS A SMALL NUMBER OF ABILITIES FROM EACH DOMAIN.' ✅ SO THIS IS AN ACCESS FLAG, NOT A CATEGORY. The craft's `tradition` is its real owner and always a POLE; this field says the pole shares it. ⛔ I FIRST DECLARED `traditionKind: "pole"|"foothill"|"folk"` from SNG-536 §2a and it was wrong in the same way the spec was: **it made folk a kind of tradition, which is the thing being retired.**
